cohort.cutoff_status: draft; confirm with owner before freeze
cohort.group_split: Group scenarios by non-sensitive opaque incident-family hash; no group may cross development and holdout. Custodian verifies related tasks, code families and shared root causes before freezing, not just identifiers.

arms.baseline: Unchanged production normalization, eligibility and selector; publish actual max-three returned lessons separately from any diagnostic top five.
arms.A: Existing shadow applicability evaluator on reviewed revision-bound records and independently evidence-bound minimal task observations. Scaffolding does not supply trusted observations.
arms.B: Verified CI evidence-only comparison using pre-registered feature construction; BLOCKED until a reproducible exact-head source and pre-registered comparator are available.
arms.C: A+B; BLOCKED until both arms are independently runnable. Never substitute static links, caller payloads or no-evidence results for verified evidence.

metrics.recall_at_5: Diagnostic ranked list only; macro over positive scenarios: |top5[lesson ID and revision] intersect valid gold| / |gold|. If an arm has no defensible predeclared ranking to five, NOT_APPLICABLE; separately report Recall@3 over actual supported output.
metrics.precision_at_3: Macro over positive scenarios: matched (ID, revision) among first 3 / 3 including empty slots; separately report returned-list precision where denominators are nonzero.
metrics.positive_hit_count: Count positive scenarios with at least one valid gold (ID, revision) in first 3; keeper metric for comparison; include cohort, denominator and paired discordance.
metrics.correct_abstention: No shadow recommendation on ABSTAIN cases. Report hard negatives separately; pipeline unavailability or underevaluation is not an abstention success.
metrics.hard_negative_false_positive_rate: Hard-negative scenarios with any recommendation / eligible pre-registered hard-negative cohort; one violation fails proposed gate.
metrics.provenance_accuracy: All proposed recommendations must be exact lesson/revision bound and use independently verified input evidence. Count provenance failures; missing provenance is unresolved, never a success.
metrics.explanation_fidelity: An independent verifier traces each recommendation reason to reviewed record ID/revision and the qualifying observation identity or known baseline reason; aggregate counts plus missing traces. Do not disclose private lesson content.
metrics.shuffle_stability: Ten pre-registered script-derived seeds permute equivalent input order only. Require identical ordered recommendation IDs/revisions, match status, stable reason codes and decision across permutations.

draft_go_no_go.pr3_shadow_program: A or fully available C has more positive hits than baseline on the same frozen cohort, zero hard-negative false positives, zero strict safety failures and 100% explanation traceability. Unmeasured arms are not candidates for recommendation.
draft_go_no_go.pr4_pr5_comparison: Only on comparable complete arms: C beats A by at least 2 positives or improves correct abstention without new false positives. Any production integration still requires separate governing approval, verified acquisition and safety gates.
